scripts.package: bun scripts/build.ts --production && cd packages/client && vsce package --no-dependencies -o ../../dist/css-modules-devtools.vsix
scripts.dev:setup: bun run package && code --install-extension dist/css-modules-devtools.vsix --force && cursor --install-extension dist/css-modules-devtools.vsix --force
scripts.dev:clean: code --uninstall-extension razgraf.css-modules-devtools; cursor --uninstall-extension razgraf.css-modules-devtools; rm -f dist/css-modules-devtools.vsix
